title: 最小栈
statement: 设计一个栈类 MinStack，除常规操作外还能随时取得栈中的最小值：MinStack() 创建空栈；push(val) 压入 val；pop() 弹出栈顶；top() 返回栈顶元素；getMin() 返回栈中当前最小元素。pop、top、getMin 只会在栈非空时调用。

en.title: Min Stack
en.statement: Design a stack class MinStack that, besides the usual operations, can return the minimum value in the stack at any time: MinStack() creates an empty stack; push(val) pushes val; pop() removes the top element; top() returns the top element; getMin() returns the current minimum element in the stack. pop, top and getMin are only called when the stack is non-empty.
constraints: pop, top and getMin are always called on a non-empty stack
Total calls to push, pop, top and getMin ≤ 30000

complexity.officialRequirement: Official requirement: every function must run in O(1) time.
complexity.notes: n is the number of elements in the stack. Use an auxiliary stack that records the minimum at each level (equal values must also be pushed), or have each element carry the minimum at the time it was pushed. The largest local test has 13000 calls (official limit is 30000, reduced to keep the problem bank small); finite tests cannot prove O(1).

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is the operation count m; then m lines, each an operation name (MinStack / push / pop / top / getMin); then a line with m, followed by m argument lines, each giving the argument count k and then k integers (1 for push, 0 for the others). stdout: line 1 is m, then m lines, one result per operation: the constructor, push and pop print null; top and getMin print an integer.

constraints: pop、top、getMin 总在非空栈上调用

complexity.time: 每个操作 O(1)（官方要求）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方要求每个函数的时间复杂度均为 O(1)。
complexity.notes: n 为栈中元素个数。辅助栈同步记录每层的最小值（相等值也要压入），或每个元素携带压入时的最小值。本地最大测试为 13000 次调用（官方上限 30000，为控制题库体积而缩小）；有限测试无法证明 O(1)。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行操作数 m；随后 m 行，每行一个操作名（MinStack / push / pop / top / getMin）；接着一行 m，然后 m 行参数，每行先写参数个数 k 再写 k 个整数（push 为 1 个，其余为 0 个）。stdout：第一行 m，随后 m 行，每个操作一行结果：构造、push、pop 输出 null，top 与 getMin 输出整数。
